q.en: When is April Fools' Day celebrated?
q.zh: 愚人节是在什么时候庆祝的？

options.en: On the first day of January, which is why people give gifts like at New Year
options.zh: 在一月一日，所以人们像过新年一样互赠礼物

options.en: On or around the first day of April

explain.en: The book says April Fools' Day is celebrated on or around the first day of April every year
explain.zh: 书中说，愚人节每年在四月一日或前后庆祝

q.en: Which of these is a popular April Fools' prank from the book?
q.zh: 以下哪一个是书中提到的常见愚人节恶作剧？

options.en: Painting the house red so the neighbors think a festival is happening
options.zh: 把房子漆成红色，让邻居以为在过节

explain.en: Popular pranks include putting grease on a doorknob or swapping the sugar for salt
explain.zh: 常见的恶作剧包括在门把手上涂油，或把糖换成盐

q.en: In France, April 1 is often known as what?
q.zh: 在法国，四月一日通常被称为什么？

options.en: The Spaghetti Day, when families cook long noodles to celebrate
options.zh: 意大利面日，家家户户煮长面条来庆祝

explain.en: In France, April 1 is often known as April Fish, and a paper fish is taped to the victim's back
explain.zh: 在法国，四月一日常被称为「四月鱼」，人们会把纸鱼贴在被捉弄者的背上

q.en: What is Sizdah Bedar, and why is it special?
q.zh: 什么是 Sizdah Bedar，它有什么特别之处？

options.en: An Iranian celebration around April 1, practiced since 536 BC, maybe the oldest joke day
options.zh: 伊朗在四月一日前后的庆祝活动，自公元前536年延续至今，可能是最古老的玩笑日

options.en: An American sports day held every April first with parades, races, and a big fireworks show at night
options.zh: 每年四月一日举行的美国运动日，有游行、赛跑，晚上还有大型烟花表演

explain.en: Sizdah Bedar is the thirteenth day of the Iranian new year, around April 1, practiced since 536 BC and possibly the oldest joke day
explain.zh: Sizdah Bedar 是伊朗新年的第十三天，约在四月一日前后，自公元前536年延续，可能是最古老的玩笑日

q.en: What fake event was staged at the Tower of London in 1857?
q.zh: 1857年，伦敦塔上演了什么假事件？

explain.en: Washing the Lions was a fake event staged at the Tower of London in England, with no actual lions present
explain.zh: 「清洗狮子」是英国伦敦塔上演的一场假事件，现场并没有真正的狮子

q.en: Why does the author include 'Tips to Avoid Being the April Fool!'?
q.zh: 作者为什么加入「避免成为愚人的小贴士」？

options.en: To help readers notice and avoid tricks
options.zh: 为了帮助读者察觉并避开恶作剧

options.en: To teach how to cook fish, since April Fish is a French food holiday
options.zh: 为了教人烹饪鱼，因为四月鱼是法国的美食节日

explain.en: The tips warn readers to read carefully and be on guard against fake stories
explain.zh: 这些提示提醒读者仔细阅读并保持警惕，以防被假消息欺骗

q.en: In 1996, which company joked that it bought the Liberty Bell?
q.zh: 1996年，哪家公司开玩笑说它买下了自由钟？

options.en: Taco Bell, calling it the Taco Liberty Bell
options.zh: 塔可钟，称之为「塔可自由钟」

options.en: BBC TV, which announced it had bought the Eiffel Tower that year
options.zh: 英国广播公司电视台，它当年宣布买下了埃菲尔铁塔

explain.en: In 1996, Taco Bell announced it had bought the Liberty Bell and would call it the Taco Liberty Bell
explain.zh: 1996年，塔可钟宣布买下了自由钟，并要把它称为「塔可自由钟」

q.en: How is this book mainly organized?
q.zh: 这本书主要以什么方式组织内容？

options.en: As informational text with sections about the world
options.zh: 以介绍世界各地情况的说明性章节组织

options.en: As a single long poem that rhymes on every page from start to finish
options.zh: 作为一首从头到尾每页都押韵的长篇诗歌

explain.en: The table of contents lists Pranking Fun, Around the World, Famous Foolery, and more informational sections
explain.zh: 目录列出了「恶作剧乐趣」「世界各地」「著名的愚弄」等多个说明性章节

q.en: In Scotland, how long can April Fools' fun last?
q.zh: 在苏格兰，愚人节的乐趣可以持续多久？

explain.en: In Scotland, April Fools' can go on for two days, with foolish errands on April 1 and more jokes the next day
explain.zh: 在苏格兰，愚人节可以持续两天：四月一日让人去做傻事，第二天再来更多玩笑

q.en: What rule does the author say April Fools' jokes should follow?
q.zh: 作者说愚人节的玩笑应该遵守什么原则？

options.en: Scare as many people as possible, because the best jokes are the scariest ones
options.zh: 尽可能吓唬更多人，因为最好的玩笑就是最吓人的

options.en: Always cost a lot of money
Be fun but harmless, and not mean

explain.en: The conclusion says the best pranks are fun but harmless, and jokes are supposed to be fun, not mean
explain.zh: 结语说，最好的恶作剧有趣但无害，玩笑本应好玩，而不是刻薄

prompt.en: The book says the best April Fools' pranks are fun but harmless. Write about a safe joke you would play on a friend, and explain why it is harmless
prompt.zh: 书中说，最好的愚人节恶作剧要有趣但无害。写一个有关于你对朋友会开的、安全的玩笑，并解释它为什么无害

en: Explain why it would not hurt anyone
zh: 解释它为什么不会伤害任何人
